higher_line_rule: last two confirmed high pivots form resistance and last two confirmed low pivots form support; project to current day/week from only prior completed higher-timeframe bars
entry: EMA25 0.5 ATR first-touch signal on closed 1H/4H bar, near projected support with EMA slope bending up for long, or near projected resistance with EMA slope bending down for short; fill next open
exit: opposite EMA25 first-touch signal closes the current side even if higher-line filter blocks the replacement entry
control: same EMA25 0.5 ATR signal without higher-line filter, identical candles and costs
primary_screen: strictly positive return in every complete calendar month and fewer closed trades than EMA25 control
annual_screen: strictly positive return in each complete calendar year; incomplete 2026 shown separately
annual_ex_post_regime: stock return from first open to last close: growth > +10%, decline < -10%, directionally_flat otherwise; diagnostic only, may include volatile paths
candidate_policy: no strategy or paper account until monthly screen, cost review and manual TradingView reconciliation
universe_selection: Top 100 SECTYPE 1/2 TQBR stocks by median close*volume of last 60 daily bars in 2026-10-30 fixed snapshot; require cached 1H and 1D files; no profitability input
prior_pilot_seen: The 10-symbol pilot and its result were inspected before this 100-symbol expansion; all results are exploratory seen_history
